Subject: a compact irregular grove of seven tall northern spruce trees of differing heights, healthy dark olive green needles, realistically layered branches and trunks, viewed mostly as crowns with a little south-facing trunk visible. Rounded asymmetric footprint, a few low ferns and roots beneath crowns, no soil slab or surrounding scenery. Height-to-width of whole grove close to square. This cluster will repeat across a forest, so no focal landmarks, no rocks, no strong directional composition.
